ThingDef.label: furnace grip
ThingDef.description: Grants +70% damage against enemies and +80% global work speed. Every fourth valid direct hit releases a 6-cell furnace pulse: up to 8 standing enemies take 180 + 75% of the direct hit as additional damage and receive 2 burn levels. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Found in abandoned foundry. Recovered through exploration; not available from ordinary drafts or directed forging. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

ThingDef.label: heat reservoir
ThingDef.description: Grants +120% body health and restores 2.5 points of ordinary injury each second. After taking damage, gain a shield equal to 300 + three times the damage taken for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds. The shield does not absorb the hit that creates it. Found in abandoned foundry. Recovered through exploration; not available from ordinary drafts or directed forging.

ThingDef.label: refraction lens
ThingDef.description: Grants +60% damage against enemies, +35 percentage points of critical chance and +150% research speed. Every third valid direct hit, if the target is at least 10 cells away, refracts into up to 4 standing enemies within 12 cells of the impact. Each takes 160 + the direct hit as additional damage and is slowed. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Found in lost research station. Recovered through exploration; not available from ordinary drafts or directed forging. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

ThingDef.label: field injector
ThingDef.description: Grants +100% body health and restores 4 points of ordinary injury each second. Every 5 seconds, treat the most injured allied free colonist within 10 cells, restoring up to 100 points of ordinary injury and granting a 160-point shield for 8 seconds. Includes the wearer. Does not activate without a treatable injury; does not regrow missing body parts. Found in lost research station. Recovered through exploration; not available from ordinary drafts or directed forging.

ThingDef.label: breach bow
ThingDef.description: Grants +100% damage against enemies and halves aiming time before other modifiers. Every fifth valid direct hit fires a piercing bolt through the target and up to 16 cells beyond it, within 2 cells of the firing line. Up to 6 standing enemies take 500 + the direct hit as additional damage. Respects walls and line of sight. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Found in sealed armory. Recovered through exploration; not available from ordinary drafts or directed forging. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

ThingDef.label: escort seal
ThingDef.description: Grants +100% body health and adds 0.7 to the damage reduction divisor. Each 200 points of actual shield absorption releases a rally pulse: heal up to 6 allied free colonists within 10 cells for 80 ordinary injury points and deal 240 additional damage to up to 8 standing enemies within 8 cells. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Stores at most 400 absorption points. Found in sealed armory. Recovered through exploration; not available from ordinary drafts or directed forging.
